metadata.description: Unified built-in LabVIEW terminal-type catalog. One entry per canonical type; `aliases` maps every spelling seen in the corpus (nodes.json's lowercase VI-Scripting vocabulary AND primitives.json's existing flat vocabulary) onto the canonical name, so any terminal `type` string encountered while importing/merging normalizes through this file.
metadata.source: LabVIEW VI Scripting node terminal data_type names (.tmp/nodes.json, issue #59) unified with lvkit's pre-existing terminal-type vocabulary (src/lvkit/data/primitives.json)

NumFloatExt.description: Extended-precision floating point (platform-native "long double"; bit width is platform-dependent, commonly 80-bit on x86)

NumComplex128.note: 'NumComplex' (primitives.json's pre-existing generic spelling) is aliased here, not to an abstract/precision-less complex type, because primResID 1044 'Complex To Re/Im' terminal idx0 uses 'NumComplex' in primitives.json and nodes.json's ground truth for that exact same terminal (same primResID, same index/direction) is 'double_complex' -- cross-referenced from .tmp/nodes.json, not guessed.

NumComplexExt.description: Extended-precision complex (two extended-precision floats; bit width is platform-dependent)

Refnum.description: Reference number (opaque handle); specific refnum family carried on the terminal as refnum_type/class_id/class_name when nodes.json supplies it, not in this catalog

Array.description: LabVIEW array (element type and dimensionality carried per-terminal, not in this catalog)

Enum.description: Enumerated ring type of unspecified bit width -- primitives.json's pre-existing generic 'enum' spelling, kept distinct from nodes.json's bit-width-specific enum_u16/enum_u32 rather than assumed to be either

Timestamp.note: 'MeasureData' (primitives.json's pre-existing spelling) is aliased here, not to Waveform, because every existing primitives.json use of 'MeasureData' (primResIDs 1303 idx0 'current_time', 8100 idx2 'timestamp', 8082 idx1 'last_mod') matches -- same primResID, same index/direction -- a nodes.json 'timestamp' terminal, cross-referenced from .tmp/nodes.json, not guessed. Elsewhere in the codebase (src/lvkit/models.py LVType.measure_flavor) 'MeasureData' names a different, unrelated concept (the waveform/digital-data underlying_type family); this catalog only covers the primitives.json/nodes.json terminal-type vocabulary and does not change that.

Waveform.description: LabVIEW waveform (element type carried per-terminal, not in this catalog)

FixedPoint.description: LabVIEW fixed-point numeric (word_length/integer_word_length/signed/overflow-status carried per-terminal, not in this catalog)

ExpressData.description: Express VI dynamic data wire type

Void.description: No data (e.g. a bare system handle)
